description:
Cast Forsaken Miner by paying {B}.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token.
The Munitions token enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its ability, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Munitions abilities, dealing infinite damage to opponents and/or permanents opponents control.
